legenda: Brooding Brazilian gaucho milonga, nocturnal and contemplative, male lead vocals singing in Brazilian Portuguese with a warm deep baritone, fingerpicked nylon-string guitar, soft chamamé accordion, upright bass, light bombo legüero, sparse arrangement building in the chorus, intimate acoustic production, high fidelity, professional mix
inspiracao: Uma milonga de vigília noturna sobre o ataque Infiltration, que se veste de tráfego benigno e engana até a Random Forest.
descricao: Milonga com violão e gaita sobre detecção de intrusão com Random Forest e o ataque Infiltration que se esconde no tráfego benigno.
